reviews.text:
This resort for us redefined what a vacation can be. The surroundings, the grounds, the room and views, the service, and the food all far exceeded expectations. We found many quiet moments of joy throughout every day that we were there.
But above all else, in this difficult world, my husband and I value kindness and gentleness above all other experiences. Being greeted with warmth and genuineness 20 or 30 times a day is a balm for the soul. The staff at Dorado Beach are the most wonderful people and the best combination of Puerto Rican authenticity and luxury resort. We will re-enter our regular busy lives fully restored. Thank you for this experience.

Omfg. Loved. Loved. Loved!!!!

From the moment you walk in to this resort, you’re just treated with the best care.

Every touch point in this resort is consistent.

The food at the restaurants can have a bit of a wait, but it’s nothing that changes the overall experience.

Our Embajador team, (mostly Raysa and Miguel) were incredible.
I prob shouldn’t share this, but they were booked for massages the only day we had available (we booked our stay here last min), and they went out of their way to get us access into the spa (which was awesome!)
Those extra little efforts make the WORLD of a difference.

Multiple restaurants to choose from, multiple pools, beautiful beach, great service.
The landscaping and the property was unmatched!
Also, the fitness classes were super fun and food was excellent.

We ate a lot of popsicles.

Highly recommend.

Everything about the resort is amazing. The spa, pools, golf course were all in great condition. We enjoyed having the bikes outside our room and being able to ride around the complex. We also enjoyed the rum you get when you first arrive.

Wow! The service here is incredible. I’ve never personally stayed here, but I’ve helped deliver food multiple times and they greet you with really cool complimentary box water.. the place itself is gorgeous, well maintained and manicured.

I stayed at the Dorado Ritz-Carlton over the summer, and I’m embarrassed to say I’m writing this review a bit late, as soon as I returned home, life hit me fast with a pile of work deadlines and a family situation that needed my full attention. But even with all that going on, I still haven’t stopped thinking about this trip, which says everything you need to know.

This was, without exaggeration, the best travel experience I have ever had.

From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, everything felt magical. The employees are truly what make this place unforgettable. Every single person we encountered went above and beyond, and the level of warmth and genuine care is something you simply can’t put a price on.
We stayed in one of the rooms with its own private pool directly in front of the beach, and waking up to that view felt surreal. The room itself was immaculate: luxurious, serene, and designed to melt stress away the second you step inside.
But the real heart of Dorado Beach is the Embajador Team. They elevated the stay from amazing to life-changing.

Thank you, Trent, Angel, and Chen, you three are extraordinary. Your attention to detail, kindness, and ability to anticipate needs before we even voiced them made the entire experience feel personalized and special. You turned a vacation into a memory my family and I will cherish forever.

If you are considering staying at the Ritz-Carlton Dorado Beach, do it. I’ve traveled all over, and nothing compares. I cannot wait to return.

I absolutely love this place! We are a little spoiled with great hotels, but this one went beyond our expectations.

The service is wonderful, the views are incredible, and everything is kept extremely clean. The hotel staff and room service are fantastic- they always made sure we had as much water and soda as we needed and kept the room spotless.

Our room has an outstanding ocean view and even two balconies, which makes the experience even more special. It’s such a beautiful place to relax and enjoy the scenery.

The food and breakfast are also really nice. There are lots of fresh fruits, baked goods, and a great omelette station. The service during breakfast is very friendly as well.

There are two pool areas—one adults-only and one for everyone—and both have hot tubs, which I absolutely love.

It’s also quiet during the nights and beds are super comfortable!
We still have one more night left out of our three-night stay, and honestly, I don’t want to leave. This place is just amazing. Thank you so much to the staff for creating such a wonderful experience for our vacation!

This is truly a beautiful place to stay. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the food was delicious, and the overall ambience was perfect. The views from the pool are simply breathtaking—it’s a lovely experience all around. A special shout-out to the spa; the service was so good I ended up going two or three times! I left feeling as relaxed as I’ve ever been. Thank you to the Hotel del Coronado and the staff for such a seamless stay. No need to look any further—this is the place to be.

I stayed here for one night via Amex Fine Hotels + Resorts. While the hotel is beautiful and the rooms are top-tier, the service was inconsistent and frustrating.

Front Desk: The person I spoke with was dismissive when I called about an early check-in. Later, after the hotel called me to say my room was ready, a staff member rudely told me to go to the back of the line just to pick up my key.

Dining: We were ignored at the bar and had to get our own drinks. At Ola, we had to hunt for coffee refills while staff stood nearby chatting about personal chores.

Baggage: It took over an hour for our bags to arrive and only because we called to ask where they were.

The room and balcony were fantastic, and the room service was high quality. The staff did send up champagne and dessert to apologize for the check-in mess, which was a nice gesture.

Interestingly, we stayed at the Condado Ocean Club next door right before this. While that property isn't as "grand" or high-end as the Vanderbilt, the service there was night and day—attentive, sweet, and professional.

For a 5-star rating, the Vanderbilt feels like the "luxury" ends at the decor. Management never followed up as promised, and I expected much more for the price.

The hotel public spaces are spectacular. Well designed and beautiful. They have created such a nice and relaxing environment. The pool areas are a huge highlight. The staff is great from the front desk, to pool attendants &
restaurant employees.
The room and bathroom are nice. Nothing overly special, but we were happy. Our room service, turn down service, and butler were fantastic.
Note: If you get a “ocean view room” it likely means partial view. When we first checked in, our ocean view room was looking right at the middle building, electrical boxes, and a view of the ocean (only if you really stuck your head out the window.) They did move us to a much better “ocean view room” aka partial ocean view room. So we were appreciative of that.
We will absolutely go back.

This was one of the most relaxing vacations I’ve ever been on. We typically do all sorts of excursions but it was my husband’s 50th birthday and the goal was just to rest and relax near the ocean.  We spent the first day in the adults only oasis sitting in a fountain loungers being served margaritas from their fantastic Tacos and Tequila restaurant. We sat in the hot tub in the afternoon- I feel like I had 10 years taken off my life. Stress flew away and by the third day I had taken off all my “mom hats” . Our room had a beautiful balcony overlooking the main pool and the ocean. We saw lots of rainbows from the balcony. We ate like royalty at their Sunday Brunch at Ola and later we enjoyed the deck in front of Ola with lovely Piña Coladas. Divine! It’s island time, time to unplug, slow down and just rest.  The resort is absolutely gorgeous, art everywhere, excellent vibes, spotlessly clean
and glamorous architecture. The atmosphere is very relaxing. The staff was kind, caring, and thoughtful . On the last night there was a free jazz concert right next to the resort that had the local Boricua energy- local music, street food, and soulful sounds. This is a special place, it’s magical, it’s romantic. It was just perfect and I’m so thankful to Condado Vanderbilt for creating such a wonderful retreat.

reviews.text: Could not have asked for a better stay.  Gorgeous ocean view room with all the amenities that you come to expect from this type of hotel.  Staff was excellent always eager to accommodate.  The hotel itself is beautiful with lively bar in the lobby featuring great music.  Overall aesthetic was beautiful and modern.  Multiple pools with great bar service.  Casino super fun!  I thoroughly enjoyed my stay!!!!!!

This is more like a 3 star property with a nice bar, a couple restaurants and club adjacent. Not worth the price, I have stayed at so many better places for around the same price. The service at the front desk started off good, when I asked if my brother could drop off my bags early in the morning they said yes he could with the bellhop and they would place it in the storage until I wake up which would literally be like 2.5 hours, just enough for me to catch up on sleep and be well rested for a very important business meeting. I went to sleep in confidence only to wake up to my brother having to wait until I woke up because they told him he needed a bracelet. That literally defeats the whole purpose and when I asked the front desk if he would need anything they said no. The Ritz Carlton, The Four Seasons, and many others never have issues, service, or communication like this.

The bathroom is very outdated, the sliding door to the shower doesn’t close all the way, the water handle is positioned in a awkward place and can’t be used at it was meant to be used, and the rainfall shower lacks pressure. The view can be nice, depending on which floor and where you are positioned.

The club was just okay, people hyped it up but coming from the US clubs it’s def nothing special. Drinks were nasty to mediocre.

The bar did have very tasty cocktails, just overpriced for what they were. I didn’t mind it since at least the flavors were there and they used cool ingredients like soursop which I enjoyed.

The pools are nice, and the restaurants I didn’t try.

Overall it was a negative experience as the communication from the very beginning made for a very disappointing situation after waking up. The shower wasn’t good at all, the drinks are overpriced, the club was meh, and I wouldn’t recommend this property.

The booking photos did not accurately reflect the room we received — they appeared to be taken with a wide-angle lens that made the space look far nicer than it actually was. While the room was a good size, it felt like two standard hotel rooms joined together rather than a thoughtfully renovated suite. There were even two separate entry doors with different room numbers and exterior doors that opened outside with no patio attached.

Our balcony was enclosed with no view, obstructed by the building’s exterior, making it technically usable but pointless since we couldn’t see anything. The windows facing the beach were also extremely dirty, further limiting any view. We also experienced significant noise from the resort side, and overall cleanliness of the property could be improved.

The location is walkable, but the surrounding area offered limited activities unless you enjoy very crowded environments. For the price paid, the value did not match expectations. As a frequent Marriott guest with consistently positive stays elsewhere, this visit was disappointing. I would choose a nearby Marriott property or Old San Juan next time.
